title: Wet Runway पर Plane Hydroplaning से कैसे बचता है? 🤯
topic: The hidden engineering of why airport runways are grooved
claims: Standard airport runway grooving specs require transversely cut channels roughly 6 mm (1/4 inch) wide and 6 mm deep spaced about 38 mm apart.
Hydroplaning occurs when water pressure builds in front of a rolling tire, lifting it off the pavement and eliminating friction.
Grooves provide high-pressure escape channels for water under heavy loads, allowing tire rubber to directly contact dry aggregate surface.

title: Why Some Leftover Food Tastes Better Next Day 😋
topic: Why some foods taste significantly better the next day after sitting in the fridge
claims: Leftover food often tastes better because flavor compounds have more time to diffuse into the food matrix.

title: Why Onion Tears Are Not Sad Tears 😭

title: Why Glacier Ice Is Intensely Blue 🤯
topic: Why glacier ice looks intensely blue instead of white like normal ice
claims: Glacier ice appears blue because the intense pressure of overlying snow layers expels air bubbles.
